1060.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Scalar grid::unit() objects controlling physical axis spacing. For horizontal or vertical collinear layouts with measured panels these distances use the physical scale perpendicular to each backbone. A negative axis.gap places the circular axis inside the backbone; a positive value places it outside. Zero attaches ticks to the inner backbone edge and is the circular default, including the plasmid preset. Circular major/minor tick lengths default to 1.5/0.7 mm, or 2.2/0.8 mm with the plasmid preset. Their default line widths are 0.45/0.3 mm, or 0.6/0.35 mm with that preset. Explicit length and line settings take priority. |

1065.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. Origin/end strings take priority and remain visible; an automatic endpoint may use either readable side of its tick, with a bounded tangential gap up to 4 mm, to clear fixed feature exit rays. Unresolved endpoint clearance is reported as endpoint_unresolved. Overlap checking may hide ordinary intermediate text while keeping its tick, with hidden_near_backbone in diagnostics. Explicit axis.text.offset values and explicit scale breaks stay fixed. |

1180.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. 1520.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Scalar grid::unit() objects controlling physical axis spacing. For horizontal or vertical collinear layouts with measured panels these distances use the physical scale perpendicular to each backbone. A negative axis.gap places the circular axis inside the backbone; a positive value places it outside. Zero attaches ticks to the inner backbone edge and is the circular default, including the plasmid preset. Circular major/minor tick lengths default to 1.5/0.7 mm, or 2.2/0.8 mm with the plasmid preset. Their default line widths are 0.45/0.3 mm, or 0.6/0.35 mm with that preset. Explicit length and line settings take priority. |

1525.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Whether overlapping axis labels are hidden. Defaults to TRUE. Automatically positioned circular parallel labels, including combined seam strings, can receive bounded inward or outward radial clearance around feature polygons and fixed annotation-leader roots. Internal and exterior annotation leaders route around the resolved axis text; mutable shoulders do not feed back into axis placement. Automatic strings stay in a near- backbone channel. Origin/end strings take priority and remain visible; an automatic endpoint may use either readable side of its tick, with a bounded tangential gap up to 4 mm, to clear fixed feature exit rays. Unresolved endpoint clearance is reported as endpoint_unresolved. Overlap checking may hide ordinary intermediate text while keeping its tick, with hidden_near_backbone in diagnostics. Explicit axis.text.offset values and explicit scale breaks stay fixed. |

1702.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "drop". Policy for rows whose sequence ID in ribbon_data or gene_data is missing, empty or unknown: "drop" removes them, "error" stops with a message, "keep" leaves them unchanged. A kept row without a reference sequence is reported, but its coordinates and annotations are not cleaned and it is not guaranteed to be drawable. IDs are never guessed or replaced. Other structural checks, including finite numeric coordinates and valid gene strands, still apply. |

1703.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "clip". Policy for coordinates outside [1, sequence length]: "clip" clamps them, "drop" removes the row, "error" stops, "keep" leaves them unchanged. Coordinates are one-based inclusive, so start == end is a valid single-base interval and is retained. With "clip", intervals wholly outside their sequence are removed and reported; partially overlapping intervals retain their intersection, even a single base. |

1704.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "sort". Policy for intervals with start > end: "sort" swaps the endpoints so the feature draws stably (the original direction is recorded in the report), "drop" removes the row, "error" stops, "keep" leaves them unchanged. |

1705.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "clip". Policy for pident outside [0, 100]: "clip" clamps them, "drop" removes the row, "error" stops, "keep" leaves them unchanged. |

1706.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "keep". Policy for missing/empty anno in gene data: "replace" fills them with replacement_annotation, "drop" removes the row, "keep" leaves them unchanged. |

1707.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "unannotated". Replacement annotation used when empty_annotation = "replace". |

Maximum absolute difference (in bp) allowed on each of qstart/qend/sstart/send for two rows to count as coordinate duplicates (used with by = "coordinates"). |

1717.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | ⟦shared:1⟧ | Type, units and accepted forms: see this API argument contract at right | Character, default "exact". "exact" removes rows with identical pair and coordinates; "coordinates" additionally treats rows within tolerance bp as duplicates; "overlap" treats blocks whose reciprocal overlap is at least min_reciprocal_overlap on both sequences as duplicates. Each interval must meet the threshold, not only the shorter one. Opposite relative endpoint directions are kept as distinct relationships by all methods. Single-base endpoints use supplied strand/direction evidence; otherwise their direction is unknown. |

An error in a registered layer's data callback stops the export and reports the layer ID together with the original cause. All registered layers participate regardless of include. Requesting only "source" with omitted or empty include returns just layer_data and layer_stage_status. This reads each source without evaluating mappings, statistics or geometry.
